# Creating a reusable design system

The process turns observable brand evidence into a system that can support many formats.

## The workflow

- 1. Capture the source: Preserve the page, visible components, imagery, and original assets.
- 2. Compile the grammar: Translate evidence into reusable design behavior.
- 3. Map the content: Identify hierarchy and relationships without rewriting the source.
- 4. Build candidates: Assemble several valid compositions and score their fit.
- 5. Render and inspect: Measure every element before creating the final artifact.

## Quality boundary

Every output must preserve the source, remain readable, and pass geometry checks before delivery.
